verdict.rationale: telli documents webhooks pushing real-time call event/status/outcome data and a REST API for programmatic access, plus conversation views showing appointment/outcome fields and call outcome analysis, supporting structured post-call data delivery. However, there's no explicit documentation of a structured schema for entities/dispositions extraction or example payloads showing the full breadth of structured fields promised. missing for 10: example webhook/API payload showing structured entities and disposition fields, documentation of a dedicated 'call outcomes' data model, independent/hands-on confirmation of data completeness.
